CustomField.label: Capability Posture
CustomField.description: The pack's headline posture, and always the WEAKER of Source_Posture__c and Target_Posture__c (interview_only < assisted < instrumented). instrumented = a real adapter reads or writes it; assisted = canonical IR plus a gap catalogue with an operator-run extraction; interview_only = no adapter, the numbers are what the client told us. Drives the above-the-fold posture sentence on the readout.
